Identify all financial transactions that occurred during the relevant period.
3. Determine if any of these transactions resulted in losses for the company.
4. For each loss-producing transaction, document the following information:
    - The nature of the transaction (e.g. sale of goods, payment of expenses, etc.)
    - The date and amount of the transaction
    - The reason for the loss
5. Ensure that all documentation is accurate and complete.
6. Review all documentation with the company accountant and make any necessary revisions.
7. Submit the final documentation to the relevant individuals or organizations.
